# MultiCore

> Native VPN client for Windows x64 and Linux x86_64 running Mihomo and Xray side by side. This repository is its public release channel.

- [Subscription server requirements (full spec)](llms-full.txt): what a subscription server, or an adapter in front of Remnawave, must do to serve MultiCore.
- [Provider docs (RU)](docs/providers.md): the same contract for humans.
- [Remnawave guide (RU)](docs/remnawave.md): panel setup for the Mihomo-only shape.
- [How MultiCore works (RU)](docs/how-it-works.md)
